class.lmpc_classes.none.role: Empty hands: no bonuses, no penalties
class.lmpc_classes.cleric.role: The party's healer in the late stages of the plague
class.lmpc_classes.cleric.lore: Brew and prayer are powerless where the plague takes its due — but the Cleric stays close when every other remedy has stopped working. A steady hand and a voice right at your ear sometimes matter more than any recipe.
class.lmpc_classes.cleric.ability.1: The pendant in the necklace slot slows infection; on a Cleric it is twice as strong as on anyone else.
class.lmpc_classes.cleric.ability.2: The improved brew cures at any stage. In other hands the bottle is simply wasted.
class.lmpc_classes.cleric.ability.3: Feed an ally: stand right next to them and hold right-click while looking at them.
class.lmpc_classes.cleric.mastery: Mastery grows with every successful cure; healing an ally is worth twice healing yourself.
class.lmpc_classes.smith.role: Defence technician, keeps the surface Purifiers running
class.lmpc_classes.smith.lore: While others run from the Blight, the Smith builds what keeps it at arm's length. A machine never tires and never fears — but it is hungry, and without its keeper it rusts like any abandoned mechanism.
class.lmpc_classes.smith.ability.1: Gear in hand and on the body slowly repairs itself — a machine with a keeper does not rust.
class.lmpc_classes.smith.mastery: Mastery grows from working at the anvil.
class.lmpc_classes.farmer.role: Turns the run for plague reagents into husbandry
class.lmpc_classes.farmer.lore: What grows as a wild bush in the Blight is a risk for anyone who goes after it empty-handed. The Farmer has tamed it: the same thing comes up in rows on the farm plot, safe and predictable, like any other harvest.
class.lmpc_classes.farmer.ability.1: Every dish is more filling: a share of its own nutrition is added on top.
class.lmpc_classes.farmer.mastery: Mastery grows with every fully grown crop harvested.
class.lmpc_classes.chronicler.lore: The Chronicler goes where nobody else wants to look, and writes down what was seen — in case they do not come back. Every photograph and every line will one day be the only testimony that any of this was here.
class.lmpc_classes.chronicler.ability.1: Sees the exact plague stage and infection points — their own and everyone nearby.
class.lmpc_classes.chronicler.mastery: Mastery grows for every minute spent near someone infected.
